component.name: Hepcat
component.summary: Mix and route app audio, microphones and devices

description.p: Hepcat is a Voicemeeter-style mixer for PipeWire with a native KDE Plasma look. Instead of a node graph, it shows mixer strips for your microphones, applications, virtual buses and output devices.

ul.li: Send any app or microphone to one or more virtual buses, each with its own fader and output device
Offer a bus as a microphone, so Discord or OBS can record exactly what goes into it
Effects on microphones, apps and buses: noise suppression, AI voice isolation, echo cancellation, gain control, noise gate, compressor, EQ and a voice changer
Routing is remembered per app and device, and reapplied when they come back
Keeps running in the system tray

description.p: Echo cancellation for apps and buses, for an app that carries a microphone such as a phone mirrored with scrcpy. The default output and input are no longer forgotten when a stream closes.
